items.verbatim_quote: We get a bakery order at 7:30 before the first rush. The driver serves three other shops on the same run. Please keep the early slot available.
items.extracted_requirement: Allow bakery deliveries around 7:30 a.m.

items.verbatim_quote: A lift after my physio appointment can take ages. I need a place near the door, even if it’s raining and my ride is late.
items.extracted_requirement: Provide covered waiting beside the main entrance pickup bay.

items.verbatim_quote: Can we see a shadow study for the houses along River before going any further?
items.extracted_requirement: Publish a shadow study for homes along River Street.

items.verbatim_quote: My Wheel-Trans ride often arrives after dinner. I can wait inside the main entrance until it comes. I’d support the plan if I could still get picked up there at 8 p.m.
items.extracted_requirement: Keep accessible pickup available at the main entrance until at least 8 p.m.

items.verbatim_quote: My dad comes for dinner on Thursdays. His ride home usually comes around quarter to eight. Please keep pickup by the lobby open that late.
items.extracted_requirement: Keep the main entrance pickup bay available around 7:45 p.m. for evening visitors who need accessible rides.

items.verbatim_quote: The bay closing at six is the part that sticks out. Evening pickup would be useful.
items.extracted_requirement: Keep accessible pickup available into the evening.

items.verbatim_quote: My bedroom faces the loading entrance. I already hear trucks backing up from the other side of the block. Six is too early.
items.extracted_requirement: Start routine commercial deliveries at 9 a.m. or later so nearby residents can sleep.

items.verbatim_quote: Six in the morning? Please move that later. I work evenings and I’m barely asleep by two.
items.extracted_requirement: Keep routine loading quiet until at least 9 a.m. for neighbours who work late.

items.verbatim_quote: I’m for the new homes. I would still move the truck start to nine.
items.extracted_requirement: Start routine commercial deliveries at 9 a.m. or later.

items.verbatim_quote: I pass through with a stroller most mornings. I don’t want to stop in a truck driveway while a driver is checking both mirrors.
items.extracted_requirement: Provide a step-free pedestrian route that bypasses the loading driveway.

items.verbatim_quote: I could support it if the kids had a way to walk past without crossing the truck entrance.
items.extracted_requirement: Give children walking past the site a pedestrian route clear of loading traffic.

items.verbatim_quote: A truck crossing there is awkward enough on a normal day. When the sidewalk is iced over you can’t exactly step aside quickly.
items.extracted_requirement: Route pedestrians away from the loading driveway.
